pages.text: Each of the Frontier's creatures acts out its physics. The $(thing)Nebuloid$() is a drifting knot of gas and dust; inside it you are blind. The $(thing)Pulsar Wisp$() pulses on an exact beat, once every one and a half seconds, and its pulse hurts and irradiates anyone it can see within ten blocks - dodge behind something between pulses.

The $(thing)Tidal Stretcher$() pulls you in harder the closer you are (a tidal force grows as 1/r³) and stretches what it grabs. The $(thing)Lens Phantom$() is never where it appears: its light reaches you bent round the void's mass, so its image stands a block or two from its body. Aim beside it.

The $(thing)Hawking Imp$() is a tiny black hole. It evaporates, and the smaller it gets the hotter and faster it burns (T ∝ 1/M) - until it pops. The $(thing)Boltzmann Brain$() fluctuates out of nothing, mutters, and is gone within half a minute unless caught.

$(thing)The Binary$(): play a Binary Black Hole Merger record - or a Gravitational Wave Echo - in the Frontier and two compact stars spiral out of the dark. Their gravitational waves carry off their orbit: they close in (da/dt ∝ −1/a³) and circle ever faster. Kill both before they meet - if they merge, the shockwave hits everything nearby, and nothing is left to loot.
